title: Prime devissage for constructible module coefficients
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, f : C \to \operatorname{Spec} k a reduced curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and \Lambda a finite commutative ring. Suppose the eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold on this fixed C for every constructible sheaf of modules over a prime field. Then they hold for every constructible \Lambda-module sheaf F [def-constructible-constructible].

source.place: Theorem 03SC proof, first two paragraphs; Proposition 03SI for reduction

proof.text: Construct a finite prime-field extension tree for the constructible Lambda-module sheaf F. This is purely a finite-coefficient sheaf statement, with no cohomological premise.
Induct on this finite extension tree. For a prime factor G, apply the given hypothesis H r G and transport the eight assertions through the underlying abelian sheaf isomorphism.
For an extension constructor apply short-exact devissage to the two induction hypotheses; constructibility of the outer terms is recorded in the tree. This yields all eight assertions for F.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 03SC, second proof paragraph; finite extension-tree induction and scalar transport formalized by V2

theorem IsCurve.assertions_of_constructible_prime_devissage
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced C]
    (H : ∀ (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
      (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
      [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf G], IsCurve.Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) f G)
    (F : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] : IsCurve.Assertions Λ f F
